faqs.question: What is Funding Traders?
faqs.answer: Funding Traders is a proprietary trading firm founded in 2023, operated by MCF Group FZCO in Dubai, UAE, with a US entity (FT US Inc) based in Miami Beach, Florida. It offers Instant Funded, 2-Step PRO6, 2-Step PRO10 and 1-Step account types on forex, indices, commodities and crypto, and has funded over 53,000 trading accounts.

seo.title: What is Funding Traders? | Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Funding Traders is a Dubai-based prop firm founded in 2023, offering Instant Funded, 1-Step and 2-Step evaluation accounts.

faqs.question: What is the Funding Traders profit split?
faqs.answer: 2-Step PRO and 1-Step PRO accounts default to an 80% trader / 20% firm split, while Instant Funded accounts default higher at 90% / 10%. Any account type can reach a full 100% split by using a paid add-on or promo code at checkout.

seo.title: Funding Traders Profit Split: 80% to 100% | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Funding Traders pays 80% by default on evaluation accounts, 90% on Instant Funded, with a 100% add-on available.

faqs.question: How often can I withdraw from Funding Traders?
faqs.answer: 2-Step PRO6, 2-Step PRO10 and 1-Step PRO accounts default to a 21-day payout schedule, with a 14-day cycle available as a paid upgrade. Instant Funded accounts pay every 14 days by default. Funding Traders publicly guarantees processing within 48 hours of a valid request, backed by a $1,000 compensation policy if that deadline is missed.

seo.title: Funding Traders Payout Cycle and 48-Hour Guarantee | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Funding Traders pays every 21 days by default (14-day upgrade available) with a 48-hour processing guarantee.

faqs.question: Which withdrawal methods does Funding Traders support, and are there fees?
faqs.answer: Withdrawals are available via cryptocurrency through Coinbase Commerce (minimum $50, fastest option) or bank transfer via Rise (minimum $200, 2–5 business days). Funding Traders does not add its own processing fee on top of these minimums, though your total profit must exceed 1% of the starting balance before a payout can be requested.

seo.title: Funding Traders Withdrawal Methods and Fees | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Funding Traders offers crypto (min $50) and Rise bank transfer (min $200) payouts with no added internal fee.

faqs.question: How does the Funding Traders scaling plan work?
faqs.answer: Funded accounts are reviewed automatically every 2 months. Traders who achieve at least 8% net profit over that cycle receive a 25% account size increase applied directly to their existing account (no new evaluation purchase required), scaling up toward a $2,000,000 total allocation cap. The profit split itself stays at its current tier through scaling unless separately upgraded.

seo.metaDescription: Funding Traders reviews accounts every 2 months and grants a 25% size increase after 8% net profit, up to $2M total.
